newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes o/n rate ends down, term paper up.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes o/n rate ends down, term paper up.

text.p: Mexico overnight rates ended down on Friday due to last-minute demand for paper from large institutions that did not wish to remain liquid over the weekend, traders said.
The overwhelming trend for the session was upward, however, due to a sharp weakening of the peso.
"They began to dump liquidity almost at the last minute, and although the deals weren't big, they did offset earlier pressures," said a trader, referring to the overnight market.
The same-day Cete closed down 10 basis points at 22.90 percent.
